secrets.name: SUMSUB_APP_TOKEN
secrets.label: Sumsub App Token
secrets.description: Your Sumsub application token. You can find this in your Sumsub dashboard under API Integration settings.

secrets.name: SUMSUB_SECRET_KEY
secrets.label: Sumsub Secret Key
secrets.description: Your Sumsub secret key used for signing API requests and JWT tokens. This is found in your Sumsub dashboard under API Integration settings.

configuration.name: SUMSUB_LEVEL_NAME
configuration.label: Sumsub Level Name
configuration.description: The KYC verification level name configured in your Sumsub account. This determines which verification flow users will go through.
